notes: Tested on a 2024 EV9 GT-Line AWD, 99.8 kWh pack, carried over to 2026 (same pack; 2026 changes the port to NACS, no pack change found). Points read from article text, not a table. Conditions: Electrify America 350 kW, Northern California; temperature not stated. First point is about 200 kW almost immediately (test started near 18%). Session was interrupted once and restarted. Applied to every EV9 on the 99.8 kWh 800 V pack (2024-2027): same pack and DC hardware; 2026+ changes the port to NACS only. InsideEVs states a ~215 kW peak; other reports of the same pack give up to ~234 kW, so peak varies with charger.
